description: A script for running performance tests in a webkit/performance testing framework, including test collection, execution, result generation, and uploading.

classes.name: PerfTestsRunner
classes.description: A class to run performance tests, handle test collection, execution, result processing, and uploading.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for test configuration.

methods.name: _collect_tests
methods.description: Collects test files based on extensions and skips.

methods.name: _start_http_servers
methods.description: Starts HTTP servers required for tests.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test run process, including build checks, test execution, and result handling.

methods.name: _output_json_path
methods.description: Determines the path for output JSON results.

methods.name: _results_page_path
methods.description: Determines the path for the results HTML page.

methods.name: _generate_results
methods.description: Generates JSON and HTML results files.

methods.name: _generate_results_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with test results and metadata.

methods.name: view_source_url
methods.description: Constructs URL to view source code on Chromium's repository.

methods.name: _datetime_in_ES5_compatible_iso_format
methods.description: Formats datetime in ISO format compatible with ES5.

methods.name: _merge_slave_config_json
methods.description: Merges slave configuration JSON data into results.

methods.name: _merge_outputs_if_needed
methods.description: Merges new results with existing JSON results if applicable.

methods.name: _upload_json
methods.description: Uploads JSON results to a server.

methods.name: _run_tests_set
methods.description: Runs a set of tests and records results.
